GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.91 (21 Sep 48) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1936)
APO 500
21 September 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Continuation of Ionosphere Measurements and Associated Research in Japan.
1. Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (10 Oct 45) SC, SCAPIN 118, dated 11 October 1945, subject: Continuation of Ionosphere Measurements and Associated Research in Japan, is rescinded.
2. It is desired that the systematic observations of the ionosphere over Japan and associated research on the propagation of radio waves be continued and the activities in the field which were formerly conducted by the Physical Institute for Radio Waves of the Ministry of Education be continued by the Electrical Communication Laboratory of the Ministry of Communications.
3. Hourly virtual height versus frequency measurements (p'f measurements) shall be continued.
4. Tabulation summaries of current observations in the internationally adopted form and copies of technical reports on ionosphere research and observations as well as on matters directly related to ionosphere research will be supplied to the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. The headings and abstracts of the technical reports will be in the English language.
5. Direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Japanese Ministry of Communications within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
